description: Probe an x402 endpoint: alive? what does it charge, on which chain, to whom? Is its 402 valid?. Calls a paid URL without paying and inspects the 402 challenge: x402 version, every accepted payment option (scheme, network, asset, USDC price in dollars, payTo, timeout), resource description, Bazaar discovery metadata, latency, and a list of spec problems that break clients. Nothing is paid. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
